title: All Polyominoes are $C_4$-face-magic
summary: For a planar graph $G = (V, E)$ embedded in $\mathbb{R}^2$, let $\mathcal{F}(G)$ denote the set of faces of $G$. Then $G$ is called a \textit{$C_n$-face-magic} graph if there exists a bijection $f: V(G) \to \{1, 2, \dots, |V(G)|\}$ such that for any $F \in \mathcal{F}(G)$ with $F \cong C_n$, the sum of all the vertex labels along $C_n$ is a constant $c$. In this paper, we prove that all polyominoes are $C_4$-face-magic.
